prompt:
Create an excellent ORIGINAL hand-crafted-looking cute PIXEL ART farm game sprite sheet, true transparent RGBA background. ONE consistent caramel puppy named Paçoca, a red triangular neck bandana, creamy peanut-shaped muzzle and chest, warm dark-brown round nose, bright small dark eyes with one-pixel highlights, two short rounded FLOPPY ears, a slim upward-curled caramel tail, FOUR short strong legs and FOUR cream paw tips. Sweet playful personality. Compact puppy proportions, chunky readable silhouette, intentional crisp pixel clusters and dark brown pixel outlines, warm 16-color palette, flat two-tone shadows. No smooth vector art, no gradients, no huge glossy eyes, no text, no props, no ground shadows.
EXACT GRID: 8 rows by 8 columns, 64 SEPARATE WHOLE puppies. Canvas square. Equal cells; every character occupies only the middle 60 percent of its cell, leaving generous clear transparent gutters, including outer margins. All tail, nose, ears and paws fully inside each cell.
Each ROW is a different genuine viewing direction. Row 1 SOUTH/front facing camera. Row 2 SOUTHWEST/front three-quarter, nose left. Row 3 WEST/left side profile. Row 4 NORTHWEST/rear three-quarter, nose left. Row 5 NORTH/back facing away. Row 6 NORTHEAST/rear three-quarter, nose right. Row 7 EAST/right side profile. Row 8 SOUTHEAST/front three-quarter, nose right. Fixed orthographic slightly elevated 20 degree game camera. Maintain exact same size, body model, floppy ears, muzzle, accessories and palette in all 64 frames. This is a four-legged DOG, never upright human.
Each row is ONE complete EIGHT DRAWING walking cycle: 1 contact A, 2 down A, 3 passing A, 4 up A, 5 opposite contact B, 6 down B, 7 opposite passing B, 8 up B returning smoothly to 1. FOUR independent paws, real elbows/hocks. Opposite fore and hind legs counterbalance. Alternate left and right evenly; never limp. Cream near paws and darker far paws remain distinguishable. Grounded paw stays level and travels back under the body; swing paw lifts, bends and comes forward. Stable torso and head volume, fixed body center, subtle ear follow-through only. Front and rear rows must show alternating LEFT and RIGHT paw motion with a visible separation between both forelegs and both hindlegs, NOT a single central leg. Do not redraw the animal's anatomy between frames. Clear relaxed friendly smile. Pixel art must read cleanly at 52 pixels high.
